about.bio:
I'm a Physicist who always like to code and then decide to work with IT. Throughout my education, I have worked for more than four years in research laboratories with interdisciplinary subjects (Microfluidics, Composite Polymers and Sensors) and taught Physics and Mathematics for more than two years. These experiences allowed me to develop the ability to analyze, propose and adapt solutions to the most diverse situations.

My career in technology began in web development and evolved into Data Engineering, where I gained experience building end-to-end solutions, from data ingestion, transformation, and modeling to making data available for analysis and production use. I’m currently focused on building and deploying Machine Learning models, particularly in People Analytics.

project.immersao.title: Data Immersion
project.immersao.description:
2nd edition of Data Immersion, organized by Alura.

Over five days of classes, the program introduced fundamental Data Science concepts and techniques using the ENEM 2019 dataset.

project.api.description: Built with the micro-framework Lumen, it follows the RESTful standard and provides authentication for database persistence.

project.pythonGuide.description: A Python study guide covering general programming concepts and key language features.
project.aulaqui.title: AulAquI
project.aulaqui.description:
A platform where people can sign up to offer private lessons.
The back end is an API built with Node.js.
The web app supports registration and browsing of tutors.
The mobile app lets users find tutors and save favorites.
project.brnoflix.title: Brnoflix
project.brnoflix.description:
A video management app with an interface inspired by Netflix, built during Alura's React Immersion.
Add YouTube videos to different categories and create new categories.
Components use the styled-components pattern, and a fake back end was built with json-server.
project.hipsta.title: Hipsta's Adventures
project.hipsta.description:
A 2D endless runner built with p5.js during Alura's GameDev Immersion.
Hipsta is late for her first day at the School of Magic. Join her as she takes a shortcut through the Evil Forest and help her overcome the obstacles.
Will she make it on time?
project.ecoleta.title: Ecoleta
project.ecoleta.description:
An app that shows suitable locations for waste disposal.
The back end is an API built with Node.js.
The web app lets users register collection points, browse them, and view their details.
The mobile app helps users find collection points by waste type and location.
project.series.title: Watched Series Manager
project.series.description:
An app for tracking TV series episodes. You and your friends can add series to your lists and mark episodes as watched.

Built with Laravel, using Blade templates for the front end.
project.phpGuide.title: PHP Study Guide
project.phpGuide.description: A PHP study guide covering general programming concepts, key language features, and widely used packages and frameworks.
project.multiTenant.title: Laravel Multi-Tenant
project.multiTenant.description:
An example multi-tenant application built with Laravel (5.8) and the Tenancy package (5.4).

Each tenant has its own hostname and independent database.
The repository includes a development guide covering the basic steps to build a similar application.
